name: How can I tell if my home needs copper repiping instead of just repairs?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my home needs copper repiping instead of just repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might need copper repiping if you experience recurring leaks, especially in multiple locations, consistently low water pressure throughout your home, or discolored water (reddish-brown) indicating internal pipe corrosion. While isolated leaks can often be repaired, widespread issues typically point to systemic pipe degradation that simple patches won't resolve long-term. This decision factor involves weighing the cumulative cost and inconvenience of frequent repairs against the comprehensive, lasting solution of a full repipe. CG Plumbing Solutions can help assess whether repiping is the most economical and effective option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repiping is likely needed for recurring leaks, widespread low water pressure, or discolored water, indicating systemic pipe degradation. An assessment helps decide between frequent repairs and a lasting repipe solution.
